values.note: Book by phone or email (a credit card holds the site). 'We do not take reservations for 1 or 2 nights' - shorter stays are presumably walk-in. Long weekends (Victoria Day, Canada Day, Heritage Day, Labour Day) need 3 nights. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 11 am. Cancel 72 hours ahead (7 days on long weekends) or pay one night (the whole stay on long weekends).

note: Family-owned RV park in Magrath (234 W 5th Ave S), about 20 minutes south of Lethbridge and away from highways and railway tracks; a nature trail leaves from the campground gate. Owners live on site. Also three rental cabins, a recreation room, a hall for rent and antique horse-drawn equipment around the grounds. Seasonal sites (five-month minimum) are sold alongside nightly ones. --Claude
